# Claude Code 2.1.286 transcript recovery fixtures

Generated by executing `jln`, `yan`, `nat`, `vmr`, `Jie`, `Smr`, and their pure
helpers extracted from the official macOS arm64 Claude Code 2.1.286 binary.
The installed binary SHA-256 is
`75e3016e9d2570767b08e43a7467d4817a4f149232c169ca295f2c95fef21433`.
Source chunk: `src_183727495.js`, located by the exact `function nat(`,
`function yan(`, and `function jln(` anchors (see the generator).

Regenerate using the directory containing the extracted source chunks:

```sh
node crates/session/tests/fixtures/recovery-2.1.286/generate.mjs /tmp/claude-code-oracle-2.1.286
```

`generate.mjs` executes the upstream functions, with telemetry disabled,
production-default recovery gates enabled, and admission/redaction treated as
identity for these valid synthetic fixtures. It deliberately supplies no compact
boundary fixtures: compaction relinking is tested separately. The output records
selected tips and exact recovered row order, rather than inferring expected
results from the Rust implementation. These fixtures cover this bounded recovery
surface; they do not establish full Claude Code compatibility.

Upstream release notes:
https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.286
